Which growth goal comes first?

This is a planning tool. It does not enroll a member, claim a profile, submit information or activate paid capabilities.

Your growth plan

Choose one growth goal to build a plan.

Practical steps

  1. Correct factual identity, location, website and category information first.
  2. Clarify pickup, delivery, accessibility, returns and contact expectations.
  3. Date and expire offers rather than leaving promotions open-ended.
  4. Measure discovery separately from transactions, customers and revenue.

Non-negotiable safeguards

  • No false stock, price or savings claims.
  • Organic results remain separate from labeled sponsorship.
  • No guaranteed sales or revenue outcomes.
